name: Sonar noise framework (normalization and chaining)
plain: A library of 30+ noise types with per-call generators, composed by chain nodes and usable for ancestral and SDE noise or as a NOISE object. It treats normalization as a first-class flag rather than leaving it to each generator.
math:
scale_noise(n): if normalized: mean, std; if |mean| > 2.5/√N: n←n−mean; if |1−std| > 2.5/√N: n←n/std. Optional dim-wise variant. Multiplied by factor.
Gaussian, Brownian, power_old, uniform, StudentT, pyramid_old and voronoi default normalized=False; most others default True.

props.normalizes_variance: yes by default, with threshold; see text

label: from code
surprise: scale_noise only corrects when mean or std deviates past 2.5/√N, so near-normal draws are left untouched.

audit.note: Default-False list is incomplete: py/noise_generation.py:576 (pyramid_old) and 1352 (voronoi) also set normalized False.
